scenarios.prompt: Write TypeScript: save a report to disk with a writeFileSync(path, contents) function it is given, which returns nothing and throws on permission or disk errors. Expose saveReport(path, contents) that returns an Either whose error side is AppError { code: 'WRITE_FAILED'; message: string } and whose success side carries no data, so it can be chained with other Either steps. Do not use try/catch.

output.result: saveReport, as a function (writeFileSync) => (path: string, contents: string) => the Either
